final: SELECT AVG(group_avg), AVG(group_avg - overall_avg) FROM (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg, (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm HAVING AVG(instownpct) > (SELECT AVG(instownpct) FROM sentimentandfundamentals))
